   *Read:* *CVR* fell -24%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-656,090 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.

     Revenue +14% because spend +65%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *Dorganize - Sistema*, its CVR went 11.11%→0.6% on 4,836 EGP spend (~63% of the swing).
